# brig service delete

Delete a service, its VM and its tokens

## Synopsis

```text
brig service delete NAME
```

Also: `brig service rm`.

## Description

Delete a service: revoke the tokens of all sandboxes attached to it, delete
their providers from the gateways that run, and delete the service's VM with
all its data, or what its controller on the host made.

On a terminal, delete asks first; --yes skips the question. Without a
terminal on standard input, as in a script, it deletes without asking.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --force` | delete a service whose VM runs |
| `-y, --yes` | do not ask for confirmation |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
